brand_description: A direct-to-consumer slow-fashion brand. Warm, a little wry, never shouty. Talks to its audience like a friend who happens to know a lot about textiles.

posts.caption: Three seamstresses, one sewing machine, a lot of coffee. That's how Halo started, and honestly? Still kind of how it runs.
New season, same rule: nothing goes into a Halo piece unless we'd wear it until it falls apart. The Reworked Denim Set just cleared that bar.
me, every Sunday night, promising to finally organize my closet by color. me, every Monday morning, wearing the same three things.
you all keep styling the Halo Wrap Dress better than our own lookbook and we're not even mad about it. keep sending these.
spent the week with our fabric mill in Porto. watched them turn deadstock cotton into yarn. this is the unglamorous part nobody posts, so here it is.
the Everyday Trouser is back in stock, in the color everyone actually asked for. no gimmick here, just pants that work.
